1 गुह् गू॑हति गू॑ह˚ते pp. गूढ॑ (q.v.) hide, cover,
keep secret. — अप hide, put away. अव cover, conceal;
 embrace.
उद् pierce or twist through. उप cover, hide, embrace. नि & विनि
cover, conceal, keep secret. — Cf. उपगूढ, निगूढ, विगूढ.

गुह m. E. of Skanda & Śiva. f. गु॑हा = prec. + cave, pit,
mine, fig. the heart. Instr. गु॑हा in secret, secretly;
 w. कृ & धा
conceal, remove.

गुहाशय a. living in hiding-places or caverns, also =
seq.
गुहाहित a. being (laid) in a secret place, in the heart.

गु॑ह्य a. (to be) hidden or covered, secret. n. a secret,
mystery, adv. secretly, in silence.
गुह्यक m. a cert. class of demi-gods.
